Name: Jehiel, Son of Jehoshaphat
Summary: Jehiel was a son of Jehoshaphat who received great gifts from his father, but the kingdom went to Jehoram the firstborn, who slew all his brethren.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat's sons, including Jehiel, received gifts of silver, gold and precious things with fenced cities, but Jehoram slew them with the sword.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Jehoram, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Gifts from a father could not protect sons from a brother's sword.
